title: Fix ShortSport message sharing — receiver cannot open sent ShortSport

requirements.text: When a user receives a message containing a shared ShortSport post, tapping/clicking that message must open and play the exact ShortSport video that was sent. The ShortSport should be displayed in the full-screen vertical reel view (ShortSportPage) scrolled/focused to the specific post, or in a modal/overlay that plays that specific video.

quotes: The user can send Shortsport but the receiver can not open to see the exact shortsport which is sended fix it

acceptanceCriteria: When a receiver taps a shared ShortSport in their message thread, the specific ShortSport video plays/opens.
The correct post (the one that was shared) is displayed — not a generic feed or an empty/error state.
If ShortSportPage is used, it scrolls to and focuses the specific shared post by its post ID.
No error or blank screen is shown when the receiver opens a shared ShortSport message.

requirements.text: In MessagesPage and any message thread component, detect when a message contains a shared post of type video/ShortSport and render a tappable ShortSport preview card. On tap, navigate to ShortSportPage with the specific post ID as a URL parameter (e.g., /shortsport?postId=<id>) so the correct short is loaded and displayed.

quotes: The user can send Shortsport but the receiver can not open to see the exact shortsport which is sended fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Shared ShortSport messages in the thread render a recognizable preview (thumbnail or play icon) that is tappable.
Tapping the preview navigates to /shortsport with the correct postId parameter.
ShortSportPage reads the postId parameter on mount and scrolls/focuses to that specific post.
Works for both the sender and receiver side of the conversation.

requirements.text: Update ShortSportPage to accept an optional postId URL query parameter. When present, the page must load and display the ShortSport with that specific ID first (scrolled into view and auto-playing), before or alongside the rest of the feed.

quotes: the receiver can not open to see the exact shortsport which is sended

acceptanceCriteria: ShortSportPage reads ?postId=<id> from the URL on mount.
When postId is present, the matching ShortSport is the first item shown and auto-plays.
If the postId does not match any loaded post, the page falls back to the normal newest-first feed without crashing.
When no postId is present, ShortSportPage behaves exactly as before (no regression).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change the backend message data model unless the shared post reference is not currently stored — only add fields if strictly necessary.
Preserve existing ShortSport feed ordering (newest-first) and auto-advance behavior.
nonGoals: Redesigning the messaging UI beyond rendering the ShortSport preview correctly.
Adding new backend endpoints unless the post ID is demonstrably not stored in shared messages.
Changing how ShortSports are recorded, created, or uploaded.
